summary.content:
Today's selection covers 72 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 46 on Artificial Intelligence and 18 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Former OpenAI exec Kevin Weil is now on the board of Stoke Space
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Big Brand Jobs Scam Targets Marketing Pros' Google Accounts
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from TechCrunch, Ars Technica, Dark Reading, The Verge, Krebs on Security and others
• **Fresh Content**: 36 articles published in the last 24 hours
